purpose: Synthetic marker replay contract, not a production font or document layout golden

mapping.U+0041: same unmodified A outline and metrics
mapping.U+0915: same unmodified A outline and metrics
mapping.U+FFFC: same unmodified A outline and metrics
mapping.U+FFFD: same unmodified A outline and metrics

reason: An explicit visible glyph at U+FFFC makes accidental marker painting deterministic without host fallback fonts. U+FFFD is a visible counterexample. U+0915 enters the complex-shaping consumer.
